objective: Production fused search retrieves the right memory at or above plain BM25 for every query type, with no privacy leak and bounded latency.
invariants: leak_count stays 0 for a declared non-owner reader
a live measurement writes nothing to the store it measures
no gated class falls below its recorded floor in regression_gate
a missing or dead arm is reported as missing, never as zero or success

stop_rules.condition: After the SKMEM-P1-07 fixes, candidate live recall at 5 is still below bm25_only for any query type: simplify the arms instead of tuning further, and hold SKMEM-R-06.
leak_count above 0 in any bench or review.
Candidate live p95 worse than baseline by more than 20 percent under comparable box load.
A live run changes the measured store.

rollback.trigger: Any invariant failure after a retrieval change merges: revert that change and rerun the class bench.
